newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hughes unit, NBC Asia in Japan TV deal.
newsitem.headline: Hughes unit, NBC Asia in Japan TV deal.

text.p: Direct TV International, a subsidiary of Hughes Electronics, said on Tuesday it signed an accord with NBC Asia, Black Entertainment Television and MCM International, under which the three channels would be broadcast by Direct's digital service Direct TV Japan.
It said in a statement published at the MIP television trade fair here that the accord marked NBC's entry into the Japanese market.
